tasks.goal: Loop gate itself: spec lock, scope check, clean-tree check, checks, read-only Grok review with streamed idle timeout, progress-aware blocking rule, CLI and docs.

Pure domain engine (FR-01/02/03 calculation core): load seed snapshot, valuation in integer cents (cash counts in the total-assets denominator but belongs to no industry), concentration alerts with strict > thresholds using unrounded exact comparison, sequential buy/sell replay from the original portfolio with validation (known symbol, positive JSON integer quantity, non-negative cash, no oversell) where a failing op reports its index and leaves the last valid result unchanged, comparison of original vs simulated. Covers AC-01..AC-04 at the engine level.

FastAPI HTTP layer + SQLite persistence (FR-04/05): GET portfolio, POST simulate, POST/GET scenarios. Scenarios store name + snapshot id + ordered ops; reopening replays them on the backend. Clear 4xx error bodies. AC-04 over HTTP, AC-05 including a real server process restart. Original portfolio never mutated.

React+TypeScript UI served by the backend: overview (totals, holdings, weights, industry distribution, snapshot time, alerts with object/actual/threshold), ordered op builder, original-vs-simulated comparison, explicit loading/empty/error states, save with name, list and reopen saved scenarios. All numbers come from the backend; the UI never recomputes business values.

Delivery: README (versions, install, init, start, URL, reopen steps), DESIGN.md (2-4 pages incl. AI collaboration record with at least one real verification), VERIFY.md (step/expected/actual/pass for AC-01..05 with screenshots), four screenshots, clean-clone install+start check script. Documents must match the actual code and loop evidence; nothing fabricated.
